text:
Lina (Partnerships): Heads-up: NimbusEdge will change their meter granularity from per-minute to per-10s and introduce a nested SKU model (base compute + optional accelerator flags) starting next Thursday. They want this to show up in the marketplace reports without breaking existing entitlements. Need quick ops plan.

Devon - Marketplace: Yikes, per-10s will blow up event counts. Do they plan to send aggregated minute summaries as well or only high-res events?

Raju (NimbusEdge): We'll send the raw 10s events for high-fidelity partners and an optional minute-aggregated feed for marketplace partners. File headers will include sku_hierarchy like "base:edge-1000|accel:gpu-x" and a report_mode flag.

Iris (Finance): For billing we must avoid double-counting when both raw and aggregated feeds are present. Proposal: trust the aggregated feed for billing if present; raw is stored for telemetry. Also specify idempotency_token per-aggregation-window.

Marek (Eng): Implementation idea: ingestion can collapse by (partner_id, sku_signature, utc_minute_window, aggregation_id). For raw events, we keep a last_seen sequence and apply dedupe with TTL 7 days. We'll add columns: sku_signature (string), aggregation_id (nullable), raw_event_count (int) and reported_quantity_minor_units (int).

Devon - Marketplace: How will entitlement mapping handle nested SKUs? E.g., customers with reserved "edge-1000" capacity should automatically cover events with accel:gpu-x unless accelerator is billed separately.

Iris (Finance): Contract rule: if accelerator tag exists and partner's plan has accel_included=false, bill accel separately. Else, roll into base usage. We need a canonical SKU mapping table maintained in Partner Ops.

Lina (Partnerships): Raju can NimbusEdge provide a mapping file for old_sku -> sku_hierarchy for a 30-day backfill? That'd help migration.

Raju (NimbusEdge): Yes, we'll provide a 30-day mapping CSV and a sample of high-res vs aggregated files for the sandbox.

Marek (Eng): Two engineering flags: "accept_high_res_events" and "prefer_aggregates_for_billing". Default for marketplace partners is prefer_aggregates_for_billing=true. ETA: small PR to ingestion service + mapping table migration by Friday.

Iris (Finance): Rounding policy for per-10s meters: convert partner_quantity to minor units, sum at billing window, then apply banker's rounding at invoice line level. This reduces rounding noise across many tiny events.

Devon - Marketplace: Agree on banker's rounding. Also add reconciliation window: 5 days for backfills/repairs. If post-window corrections occur, generate an adjustment memo and flag partner for review.

Lina (Partnerships): Action items: Raju deliver sandbox files (owner Raju), Marek open PR for schema + feature flags (owner Marek), Iris update billing playbook (+sample entries) (owner Iris), Devon update marketplace ingestion docs and mapping cadence (owner Devon). Sync tomorrow 09:30 PT.

recon-bot: Note: ingestion-schema-change-detect for NimbusEdge scheduled for 2026-05-12T06:00:00Z. Monitor duplicate_rate and aggregate_conflicts for 72h.

Marek (Eng): One more note: we should tag rows with source_granularity ("10s" or "60s") and keep original_event_timestamp for forensic reconciliation.

Raju (NimbusEdge): We'll also surface an "aggregation_id" for each minute aggregate so you can link aggregated rows to their raw parents if needed.

Iris (Finance): OK. If everyone is aligned I'll draft the billing FAQ for partners describing how nested SKUs map to bills and when accelerators are chargeable.

Lina (Partnerships): Perfect. Thanks all.
